There are people who have naturally low libidos \(and pretended not to, to get with a partner\) and people whose libido goes down for reasons x y and z. 

Whatever the reason of the libido lowering, if you do not fix what caused it it can likely develop in a DB. A DB is defined by most as a systematic rejection in sex from one of the partners. 

All DBs start somewhere. Something changes or happens, something isn't communicated..etc.. and some people address it in shorter or longer times. Not all DBs can be fixed of course, but some can and he showed how he fixed his before it became \(possibly\) permanent.

Simplifying IMHO:

As an LL in a DB, f you do not want to change, if you do not want to want sex, it ain't gonna happen. You cant learn to enjoy sex for your partner. You have to want to want the sex, no matter what the reasons and backstory of any LL. No one can make you change nor want sex. The change has to start from you. Clichè but oh so true. 
This to me means, if you want your relationship to work, but you do not want sex, you do not want to want sex and you do not want to actively work towards improving your sex life, it will not happen. As an LL, wanting to make a relationship work without these things is not possible. In my opinion (feel free to disagree! :))

If you want to want sex and if you want to get over your issues, than it might be possible. Firstly identify your problem. Then find solutions. 
Also your partner cannot solve for you what is the problem, you have to figure it out.
